prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single universally “best” broker — the right one depends on your needs (individual vs employer plan, Medicare vs Marketplace), location (Kansas City, MO vs Kansas City, KS), and preferences (fee-based vs commission, in-person vs virtual, language). I can help you find a great fit. A few quick questions first:

- Which Kansas City (MO or KS) and what ZIP code?
- Are you shopping for individual/family (ACA), Medicare, or an employer/group plan?
- Do you prefer an independent broker (can show multiple carriers) or are you okay with a captive agent (one carrier)?
- Any other priorities (bilingual, evening appointments, cost transparency, in-person)?

How to find and pick a top broker
- Use official/credible directories:
  - NAHU “Find an Agent” (National Association of Health Underwriters)
  - Healthcare.gov “Find Local Help” for Marketplace enrollment
  - Your state insurance department site (Missouri Department of Commerce & Insurance or Kansas Insurance Department) to confirm licensing and complaints
  - Medicare.gov or your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for Medicare help
- Prefer independent brokers who work with multiple carriers if you want unbiased comparisons.
- Check online reviews (Google, Yelp, BBB) and LinkedIn for experience and client feedback.

Key qualifications and red flags
- Licensed in your state (ask to see license number and verify it online).
- Experience with the plan type you need (ACA, Medicare Advantage/Part D, small-group).
- Clear disclosure of whether they charge fees or are paid by insurers (ask for written fee/commission policy).
- Red flags: pressure to enroll immediately, unwillingness to provide written plan comparisons, unclear compensation, poor communication.

Questions to ask a broker
- Which carriers/plans do you usually recommend for people like me and why?
- How are you paid (fees or commissions)? Can you provide that in writing?
- Will you provide a side-by-side comparison of costs (premiums, deductibles, out‑of‑pocket, network)?
- Do you assist with enrollments, renewals, claims, and year‑round support?
- How many clients like me do you currently help? Can I see references or reviews?

If you want, give me your ZIP code and whether this is for ACA, Medicare, or employer coverage and I’ll recommend how to find highly rated brokers near you and draft a short outreach message you can send to interview them.
